in_text_mentions: Following the second dose, the patient noticed multiple erythematous lesions over the anterior chest wall. Despite the appearance of lesions, she continued the medication until the fourth dose, following which the lesions became more prominent and medical attention was sought. She was subsequently referred to the dermatology outpatient department. A detailed description of the day of presentation is shown in Figure 1.
